name: Veo 3.1 Text To Video
description: Veo 3.1 Text To Video is available in the Business API catalog.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

negative_prompt.description: Text describing what to avoid in the video.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

person_generation.description: Policy for generating people in the output.
person_generation.title: Person Generation

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

enhance_prompt.description: Whether the provider may rewrite the prompt for better results.
enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Defaults to a random seed.
seed.title: Seed

compression_quality.description: Output encoding quality. Defaults to optimized (smaller files).
compression_quality.title: Compression Quality

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 3 reference image URLs to guide generation. Requires duration=8.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
